title: What transforms experiences of interconnection into enduring compassionate action and planetary flourishing?

models.name: transient_state_model
models.position: Experiences of interconnection may be meaningful yet fade without producing durable behavioural or institutional change.

models.name: integration_and_practice_model
models.position: Durable change depends on repeated practice, psychological integration, supportive relationships and opportunities for action.

models.name: social_reinforcement_model
models.position: Communities and social norms determine whether compassionate intentions become stable habits or dissipate.

models.name: structural_constraint_model
models.position: Institutional incentives, inequality and material conditions may dominate individual intentions and limit compassionate outcomes.

models.name: multilevel_transformation_model
models.position: Lasting planetary benefit may require interacting individual, relational, institutional and ecological changes rather than a single intervention.

claims.text: BQ004 currently has no adjudicated substantive answer or accepted evidence batch.
claims.uncertainty: No causal, clinical, social or metaphysical conclusion is implied.

open_questions: Which experiences of interconnection predict durable compassionate action rather than temporary self-report?
Which integration practices, relationships and material conditions mediate lasting change?
What adverse effects, spiritual bypassing, coercion or moral licensing can accompany transformation narratives?
How do individual changes interact with institutions, inequality, culture and ecological constraints?
Which outcomes can be measured prospectively across months or years?
How can Indigenous and culturally situated knowledge inform inquiry without extraction or flattening?
Which indicators capture flourishing without treating one culture's values as universal?
